en: Hello JENNIE It is so nice to meet you Hello Welcome to the studio.
zh: 你好 JENNIE 很高兴见到你 你好 欢迎来到录音室。

en: Thank you for stopping by and congratulations on all the news the announcements Congrats on Ruby.
zh: 感谢你抽空过来 也恭喜你最近所有的消息和官宣 恭喜 Ruby。

en: Thank you Coachella Coachella It’s the LA accent.
zh: 谢谢 Coachella Coachella 是洛杉矶口音。

en: It’s wearing on me.
zh: 我都被它带跑了。

en: So many fun things happening and I can’t wait to dive into a bunch of it with you.
zh: 最近有很多有趣的事情发生 我已经迫不及待想和你深入聊聊了。

en: Gotta start with like JENNIE Everyone wants to be like JENNIE.
zh: 必须从 JENNIE 开始聊 大家都想成为像 JENNIE 一样的人。

en: no Has that been such a surprise to see how like massive it’s gotten just right when your album comes out.
zh: 没有 看到它在你专辑刚发行时就变得这么火爆 有没有让你很惊讶。

en: It’s crazy I was just saying even today I was like wow I’m just so amazed at how the song is doing and how everyone’s reacting to the song.
zh: 真的很疯狂 我今天还在说 我真的很惊讶这首歌的表现以及大家对它的反应。

en: It’s definitely not what I expected.
zh: 这完全不是我预期的。

en: I didn’t probably know what to expect but yeah I’m glad.
zh: 我其实也不知道该期待什么 但总之我很开心。

en: Because when you put it out you’re not thinking like oh I think that song is going to do well.
zh: 因为你发布的时候并不会去想 哦我觉得这首歌会火。

en: or that song is it’s just kind of nice to see the fans you know blow it up.
zh: 或者那首歌会怎样 看到粉丝把它推火真的很开心。

en: When you scroll on social media are you seeing like your own song Is it coming up the trends.
zh: 当你刷社交媒体的时候 会看到自己的歌吗 会出现在趋势里吗。

en: I am! Is that trippy?
zh: 会的！这会不会有点魔幻？

en: Yeah I don’t enjoy it. No?
zh: 是啊 其实我不太享受。不是吗？

en: I mean it’s cool but then like if it keeps happening.
zh: 我是说挺酷的 但如果一直发生的话。

en: it’s like you hear yourself so many times and you’re like ah.
zh: 就会一直听到自己的声音 然后就会觉得 啊。

en: If I hear myself my voice.
zh: 如果我听到自己的声音。

en: oh it’s the same thing I know exactly what you’re talking about.
zh: 哦 是一样的 我完全懂你在说什么。

en: And your rapping is so good Thank you.
zh: 而且你的说唱真的很好 谢谢。

en: It’s been so fun to see like your journey and development.
zh: 看到你的成长和变化真的很有意思。

en: How do you think your sounds evolve and like in your you know your own project for the first time as well.
zh: 你觉得你的音乐风格是如何进化的 这是你第一次做个人项目。

en: I’ve noticed that I didn’t realize how many genres and different type of sounds that I wanted to tap into before I worked on this album.
zh: 我发现 在做这张专辑之前 我没有意识到自己想尝试这么多不同的风格和声音。

en: And you know I’m finding myself really as I’m going I’m learning.
zh: 而且我是在这个过程中慢慢找到自己 我在不断学习。

en: how to rap for the first time almost how to sing for the first time.
zh: 几乎是第一次学习怎么说唱 第一次学习怎么唱歌。

en: Because I’ve never like in a good way I’ve never been able to really focus on only on myself.
zh: 因为从好的方面来说 我以前从来没有真正只专注于自己。

en: I’ve always had the girls with me you know I’ve always had other things happening around me.
zh: 我一直都有成员在身边 也总有其他事情在发生。

en: But for this for this album I got to really sit down and explore different voices and sounds.
zh: 但这张专辑让我可以真正坐下来 探索不同的声音和表达。

en: And it was great So.
zh: 这真的很棒。

en: I’m looking into I’m going to look into it and find out more about who and what kind of sound that I want to like hold on to.
zh: 所以我会继续去探索 找到自己想坚持的那种声音和方向。

en: So you’re getting to experiment a little bit.
zh: 所以你现在可以多做一些尝试了。

en: Is your confidence and like comfort level at like an all time high for making music.
zh: 你现在在做音乐时的自信和舒适度是历史最高吗。

en: No I feel like I need more time in the studio for me to feel that way.
zh: 没有 我觉得我还需要更多时间在录音室里才能达到那种状态。

en: But I think it was a great start.
zh: 但我觉得这是一个很好的开始。

en: And I’ve met so many amazing people on the way to and they’ve inspired me in a way that I was able to finish this album.
zh: 而且这一路上我遇到了很多很棒的人 他们以某种方式激励了我 让我完成了这张专辑。

en: So I can’t wait to get back in you know get into it more.
zh: 所以我迫不及待想回到录音室 继续深入去做。

en: You feel like a workaholic a little bit like you just love to keep working.
zh: 你会觉得自己有点工作狂吗 就是很喜欢一直工作。

en: You know what though it’s not all work that I love So I don’t consider myself as a workaholic Wait do I Oh man.
zh: 其实也不是所有工作我都喜欢 所以我不觉得自己是工作狂 等等 我是吗 天哪。

en: Well there’s so many fun collabs Congratulations on all these friends that are hopping on the project.
zh: 这次有很多很棒的合作 恭喜你有这么多朋友参与这个项目。

en: You and Dua Lipa sound so good together.
zh: 你和 Dua Lipa 的声音搭在一起很好听。

en: Our voices though I love it too I love our voices together.
zh: 我们的声音 我也很喜欢 我也很喜欢我们在一起的声音。

en: I loved hearing this song I remember for the first time and it’s like a perfect peanut butter jelly sandwich you know.
zh: 我第一次听到这首歌的时候就很喜欢 就像完美的花生酱果酱三明治一样。

en: Or like when you get the right amount of coffee creamer in your coffee it’s like.
zh: 或者就像咖啡里加了刚刚好的奶精一样。

en: thank you It flows so well together.
zh: 谢谢 它们融合得非常自然。

en: Such a sweet compliment Thank you I appreciate that.
zh: 真是很甜的夸奖 谢谢 我很感激。

en: I was so curious about like you guys have been friends for a little bit too What have you learned from just your friendship with her.
zh: 我很好奇 你们也认识一段时间了 从你们的友谊中你学到了什么。

en: She’s a caring person in general.
zh: 她本身就是一个很关心别人的人。

en: And we used to like do dinners and we would meet at parties.
zh: 我们以前会一起吃饭 也会在派对上见面。

en: And every time she’s always like making sure if I’m good and happy and healthy is everything good around you.
zh: 而且每次她都会确认我过得好不好 是否开心 是否健康 身边的一切都好吗。

en: So she’s someone that’s always made sure that I feel you know I’m feeling good.
zh: 所以她一直让我感觉很好。

en: So to have her work on a song on this album.
zh: 所以能让她参与这张专辑的歌曲。

en: she it’s like a great it’s it’s like having a great friend at work with you you know.
zh: 就像是在工作中有一个很好的朋友陪在你身边。

en: Like what more can I ask for She’s supportive and she’s obviously giving sharing her beautiful voice with me on this album.
zh: 我还能要求什么呢 她很支持我 而且也把她美妙的声音分享给了这张专辑。

en: Like I’m just so happy And it was a great day when we had the shoot.
zh: 我真的很开心 而且我们拍摄那天也很棒。

en: It felt like we were just out in New York in the cold wearing crazy outfits just jamming to a song.
zh: 感觉就像我们在纽约的寒冷中 穿着很夸张的衣服 一起随着音乐摇摆。

en: She really is like a comfort human right like your comfort support human.
zh: 她真的就是那种让人安心的人 对吧 就是你的情绪支撑。

en: She just has that presence about her And she’s got to be one of them for you.
zh: 她身上有那种气场 对你来说她一定是其中之一。

en: But being honored coming up at Billboard’s Women in Music you’re one of the global forces for 2025 Sounds so cool.
zh: 而且你还将在 Billboard Women in Music 上被表彰 你是2025年的全球力量之一 听起来很酷。

en: Obviously you know your mom is such an important figure in your life.
zh: 当然你也知道 你的妈妈在你的人生中非常重要。

en: But what about some other women that have inspired you and helped shape your journey.
zh: 但还有哪些女性也启发了你 并塑造了你的成长之路。

en: On my team there’s so many strong women or I have so many strong women around me that are really in every step of the way that I’m in.
zh: 在我的团队里有很多很强大的女性 或者说我身边一直有很多很强大的女性陪伴着我走每一步。

en: So to have that bond to always kind of shows taught me a way to respect them.
zh: 所以这种联系一直让我学会去尊重她们。

en: And and I’ll always be learning from people around me.
zh: 而且我也会一直从身边的人身上学习。

en: So to to be someone for to be that person for somebody else would be you know an honor.
zh: 所以如果我也能成为别人那样的人 那会是一种荣幸。

en: And you know I want to do well and take care of this honor; of course.
zh: 而且我也希望能把这份荣誉做好并好好珍惜 当然。
